title: BTAFK
description: A server-side utility mod for Better Than Adventure
body:
BTAFK is a collection of server-side utilities, primarily being a AFK plugin for Better than Adventure servers, but planned to include much more.

Current features:

AFK messages for players becoming/no longer being afk.

First Join messages for new players.

Discord messages for all of the above via optional dependency [MelonUtilities](https://github.com/MelonModding/MelonUtilities).

Comprehensive configuration of nearly every option. Allows customizing all mod messages, and enabling/disabling features as needed.
